# HsvColor

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct HsvColor(float H, float S, float V, float A = 1f)
```

A color as hue, saturation and value, for changing one of them: `(HsvColor.FromColor(color) with { V = 1f }).ToColor()` is the color at full brightness.

## Properties

### A

```csharp
public float A { get; init; }
```

The alpha, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque), which isn't premultiplied.

### H

```csharp
public float H { get; init; }
```

The hue, in degrees. Red is 0, green 120 and blue 240, and it wraps around.

### S

```csharp
public float S { get; init; }
```

The saturation, from 0 (gray) to 1.

### V

```csharp
public float V { get; init; }
```

The value, from 0 (black) to 1.

## Methods

### FromColor

```csharp
public static HsvColor FromColor(Color color)
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

Gets a color as hue, saturation and value, with its alpha.

### ToColor

```csharp
public Color ToColor()
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

Gets this as a [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md), wrapping [`H`](#h) around the wheel and clamping [`S`](#s) and [`V`](#v) to their ranges.
